d: We are seeking technically skilled and security-focused professionals for the positions of Telecommunications Engineer / Cybersecurity Engineer. These roles focus on telecommunications infrastructure, network engineering, information security, system protection, and the development of reliable and secure technology solutions. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong technical knowledge, analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and an understanding of network architecture, communication systems, and cybersecurity principles.

Responsibilities include designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing telecommunications networks, IT infrastructure, and information security systems. Telecommunications Engineers will support network planning, communication equipment configuration, signal performance evaluation, connectivity troubleshooting, and infrastructure maintenance. Cybersecurity Engineers will focus on identifying security vulnerabilities, monitoring network threats, implementing protective controls, and strengthening organizational information security frameworks. Additional duties include conducting technical assessments, investigating network incidents, managing system configurations, reviewing security policies, performing vulnerability assessments, and maintaining technical documentation. They will also collaborate with IT operations, infrastructure, and security teams to resolve technical issues, improve network performance, protect sensitive information, and ensure compliance with relevant technical and security standards.
Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of telecommunications systems, network architecture, and information security principles.
Knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, wireless networks, and network infrastructure.
Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection systems, encryption, and network security controls.
Understanding of cybersecurity risk assessment, vulnerability management, and incident response.
Knowledge of network monitoring, troubleshooting, and system performance evaluation.
Familiarity with relevant tools, technologies, and industry security standards.
Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Security+, CEH, or equivalent are advantageous.
Strong analytical, technical problem-solving, and communication abilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to network reliability, information security, and continuous improvement.
